title: Credential stuffing against player accounts
description: Automated credential stuffing succeeds against weak or reused player passwords.
assumptions: Assumes twelve hours of elevated account resets and mandatory player notification.

title: Cheat injection through a modified game client
description: Modified clients bypass integrity checks and inject aim and wall-hack behaviour.
assumptions: Assumes a measurable drop in new-player retention while detection lags the cheat release.

title: Virtual economy exploit allows item duplication
description: A gameplay service bug lets duplicated items reach the player-to-player market.
assumptions: Assumes duplicated items are traced and removed within one pricing cycle.

title: Payment fraud and chargeback abuse in the storefront
description: Stolen payment instruments are used to buy virtual currency and then charged back.
assumptions: Assumes the acquirer raises processing fees after the next fraud threshold breach.

title: Storefront payment outage during a seasonal sale
description: A payment provider incident stops purchases during the highest-revenue weekend.
scenario_name: Sale weekend payment outage - worst case
assumptions: Assumes a four-hour outage at peak concurrent purchasing.

title: Compromise of release signing keys in the build pipeline
description: Attacker access to pipeline secrets would let signed malware ship as a first-party update.
assumptions: Assumes withdrawal and re-signing of the affected release plus emergency patching.

title: Regional carrier failure during a global launch
description: A single upstream carrier loses routes and one region cannot reach matchmaking.
assumptions: Assumes one region is degraded for eight hours on launch weekend.

title: Non-compliance with age assurance and minors data rules
description: Age gating and parental consent controls do not meet current regional requirements.
scenario_name: Regulatory penalty and remediation - worst case
assumptions: Assumes a supervisory fine plus a forced rebuild of the consent journey.

title: Data breach at the player support SaaS provider
description: Support ticket data is exposed through a vulnerability in the hosted support platform.
assumptions: Assumes notification of affected players and a contractual security review.

title: Live telemetry gaps break matchmaking balance tuning
description: Ingestion lag starves the balance-tuning model and matchmaking quality drifts.

title: Compromised launcher update channel distributes a malicious build
description: A hijacked update channel serves a trojanised launcher to players.
assumptions: Assumes a full channel rollback and emergency client re-verification.

title: Insider exfiltration of an unreleased game build
description: A departing developer copies pre-release content out of the build pipeline.
assumptions: Assumes leaked marketing beats and a first-week sales impact.

title: Ransomware encryption of the player data warehouse
description: Domain-wide encryption halts analytics and the regulatory reporting pipeline.
assumptions: Assumes three days of degraded reporting and external forensics.

title: Cryptomining abuse drives runaway cloud spend
description: Compromised service credentials are used to launch mining workloads inside the game account.
assumptions: Assumes the burst is caught by the monthly anomaly review rather than in real time.

title: Unpatched image library on the launcher
description: A transitive image-decoding dependency carried a known remote code execution flaw.
scenario_name: Launcher remote code execution - base case
assumptions: Scenario retained for the assessment history after the patched build shipped.

title: Missing transport encryption on the legacy support portal
description: The legacy help site served authenticated pages over plain transport.
